 * 创建互斥分支组：仅当前指挥人且事件处于 COMMANDING；指定 2~5 个 OPEN 任务，
 * 每任务最多属一组；组版本初始 1。混入终态成员、成员已属另一组或事件非
 * COMMANDING 均 422 且整次不建组。groupKey 事件内幂等：同键同成员集合返回

 */
@Transactional
public BranchGroupView createBranchGroup(String incidentKey, String actor,
                                         BranchGroupCreateRequest req) {
    String commandKey = requireText(req.commandKey(), "commandKey");
    String groupKey = requireText(req.groupKey(), "groupKey");
    List<String> memberKeys = req.memberTaskKeys() == null ? List.of()
            : req.memberTaskKeys().stream()
                    .map(k -> requireText(k, "memberTaskKey"))
                    .distinct()
                    .toList();
    if (memberKeys.size() < MIN_BRANCH_GROUP_MEMBERS
            || memberKeys.size() > MAX_BRANCH_GROUP_MEMBERS) {
        throw ApiException.badRequest("分支组成员数必须为 " + MIN_BRANCH_GROUP_MEMBERS
                + "~" + MAX_BRANCH_GROUP_MEMBERS + " 个");
    }
    Incident incident = lockIncident(incidentKey);
    requireCommander(incident, actor);
    return runIdempotent(commandKey, "branch_group_create",
            hash(incidentKey, actor, groupKey, String.join(",", memberKeys)),
            BranchGroupView.class, () -> {
                if (incident.status() != IncidentStatus.COMMANDING) {
                    throw ApiException.unprocessable(
                            "仅 COMMANDING 状态可创建分支组，当前状态: " + incident.status());
                }
                var existing = branchGroups.findByKey(incident.id(), groupKey);
                if (existing.isPresent()) {
                    IncidentBranchGroup found = existing.get();
                    List<String> existingMembers = branchGroups.listMemberTasks(found.id())
                            .stream().map(IncidentTask::taskKey).sorted().toList();
                    if (!existingMembers.equals(memberKeys.stream().sorted().toList())) {
                        throw ApiException.conflict("groupKey 已被不同成员集合使用: " + groupKey);
                    }
                    return toGroupView(found);
                }
                List<IncidentTask> members = new ArrayList<>();
                for (String memberKey : memberKeys) {
                    members.add(tasks.findByKey(incident.id(), memberKey)
                            .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound("任务不存在: " + memberKey)));
                }
                for (IncidentTask member : members) {
                    if (member.status() != TaskStatus.OPEN) {
                        throw ApiException.unprocessable("成员任务已处于终态 "
                                + member.status() + "，不能加入分支组: " + member.taskKey());
                    }
                    if (branchGroups.findGroupByTaskId(member.id()).isPresent()) {
                        throw ApiException.unprocessable(
                                "任务已属于其他分支组: " + member.taskKey());
                    }
                }
                Instant now = now();
                long groupId = branchGroups.insert(new IncidentBranchGroup(0L, incident.id(),
                        groupKey, BranchGroupStatus.OPEN, 1L, null, null, null,
                        actor, now, now));
                for (IncidentTask member : members) {
                    branchGroups.insertMember(groupId, member.id(), now);
                }
                return toGroupView(branchGroups.findByKey(incident.id(), groupKey).orElseThrow());
            });
}

            hash(incidentKey, actor, groupKey, taskKey, String.valueOf(expectedVersion)),
            BranchGroupView.class, () -> {
                IncidentBranchGroup group = branchGroups.findByKey(incident.id(), groupKey)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound("分支组不存在: " + groupKey));
                List<IncidentTask> members = branchGroups.listMemberTasks(group.id());
                IncidentTask chosen = members.stream()
                        .filter(t -> t.taskKey().equals(taskKey)).findFirst()
                        .orElseThrow(() -> ApiException.notFound(
                                "任务不是分支组 " + groupKey + " 的成员: " + taskKey));
                if (group.status() == BranchGroupStatus.CHOSEN) {
                    throw ApiException.conflict("分支组已完成选择，不能再次选择: " + groupKey);
                }
                if (group.version() != expectedVersion) {
                    throw ApiException.conflict("分支组版本不匹配，期望 " + expectedVersion
                            + "，当前 " + group.version());
                }
                List<String> unresolved = unresolvedBlockers(chosen.id());
                if (!unresolved.isEmpty()) {
                    throw ApiException.conflict("存在未解除阻塞的事件: "
                            + String.join(",", unresolved), List.copyOf(unresolved));
                }
                Instant now = now();
                int updated = branchGroups.markChosen(group.id(), expectedVersion,
                        chosen.id(), actor, now);
                if (updated == 0) {
                    throw ApiException.conflict("分支组已被并发选择: " + groupKey);
                }
                tasks.markDone(chosen.id(), actor, now);
                for (IncidentTask sibling : members) {
                    if (sibling.id() != chosen.id()) {
                        tasks.markCancelled(sibling.id(), actor, now);
                    }
                }
                return toGroupView(branchGroups.findByKey(incident.id(), groupKey).orElseThrow());
            });
}

## 实现范围

**互斥分支组（exclusive branch groups）**，沿用现有分层与幂等/并发约定：

- **Schema**（`schema.sql` / `schema-h2.sql` / `src/test/resources/schema.sql` 三处同步）：新增 `incident_branch_groups`（`(incident_id, group_key)` 唯一、版本初始 1、`chosen_*` 仅 CHOSEN 有值，中文 COMMENT 与实体 Javadoc 同步）和 `incident_branch_group_members`（`task_id` 唯一约束保证每任务最多属一组）
- **新类型**：`BranchGroupStatus`（OPEN→CHOSEN）、`IncidentBranchGroup`、`IncidentBranchGroupRepository`（选择用 `UPDATE ... WHERE status='OPEN' AND version=?` 条件更新兜底并发）
- **Service**（`IncidentService` 末尾新增）：
  - `createBranchGroup`：仅当前指挥人且事件为 COMMANDING，2~5 个 OPEN 成员；混入终态成员/成员已属别组/事件非 COMMANDING 均 **422 且整次不建组**；groupKey 事件内幂等；**权限校验先于幂等重放**
  - `chooseBranch`：带 `expectedGroupVersion`，未知组/成员 **404**，已 CHOSEN 或版本不匹配 **409**，选中成员阻塞未解除 **409**（返回未解除事件列表）；成功原子完成：选中 DONE、兄弟 CANCELLED、组 CHOSEN 且版本+1；不改变事件状态、不替代原 RESOLVED 门禁
  - `completeTask`/`cancelTask` 对组内任务一律 **409**，不能绕开整组选择
- **Controller**：`POST /{k}/branch-groups`、`GET /{k}/branch-groups`、`POST /{k}/branch-groups/{g}/choose`，沿用 `X-Actor-Id` 身份头与 commandKey 幂等体系（同参回放首次响应、异参 409、失败不占键）

## 验证结果（实际运行）

- `./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain classes` / `test` / `build`：**全部 BUILD SUCCESSFUL**
- 测试报告：13 个测试类 **72 个用例，0 失败、0 错误、0 跳过**；新增 9 个分支组用例全部真实执行：

  - `IncidentBranchGroupConcurrencyTest`（4，真实 H2 事务 + 闩门并发）：并发争选不同成员**恰一份提交**（终态 1 DONE + 1 CANCELLED、版本 2）、并发建组抢同一任务恰一成功（422）、选择 vs 普通完成（完成被 409 拦截）、交接后旧指挥人 409 仅新指挥人可提交
